sections.title: Biotech Research Knowledge Chatbots
sections.description: For Biogen (Cambridge HQ), Moderna (Cambridge HQ), and Boston's world-class biotech research community.

blocks.heading: Scientific literature chatbots
paragraphs: Self-hosted RAG chatbots for biotech research scientists — natural language query over PubMed, proprietary research databases, and internal scientific reports for drug discovery and clinical development teams. Boston's scientists have deep domain expertise and low tolerance for hallucinations — ClickMasters designs Boston scientific chatbots with citation verification, confidence scoring, and source attribution as non-negotiable requirements.

blocks.heading: Regulatory and clinical guidance chatbots
paragraphs: Chatbots for Boston biotech regulatory affairs teams — querying FDA guidance documents, ICH guidelines, and clinical trial precedents for the regulatory submissions and clinical program designs that Boston biotech companies produce. The regulatory complexity of novel drug development creates chatbot knowledge requirements that generic LLM applications don't address.

blocks.heading: Laboratory procedures and safety chatbots
paragraphs: Internal knowledge chatbots for laboratory operations — answering safety questions, SOPs, equipment calibration procedures, and laboratory compliance requirements for the large research laboratory workforces at Boston's biotech companies.
Self-hosted Llama 3 on corporate infrastructure — research IP stays within company network.
